simple.meaning: פְּתַחְיָה (Pᵉthachyâh) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in 1 Chronicles, Ezra, Nehemiah, beginning at 1 Chronicles 24:16. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, kingship.

simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows פְּתַחְיָה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

timeline.evidenceText: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,
Of the Levites: Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah (also called Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, “Stand up and bless Yahweh your God from everlasting to everlasting! Blessed be your glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise!
Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.

Pethachyah מְּתַחְיָה proper name, masculine 1 priest 1Chr 24:16 , Εζεκηλ , φεθεια etc. 2 Levite Ezra 10:23 ; Neh 9:5 , φαθαια , φεθεια ( ς ) etc. 3 Judahite Neh 11:24 , Παθαια φαθαια . עֲשַׂב noun [masculine] herbage, grass (see Biblical Hebrew עשׂב ); — emphatic עִשְׂבָּא , as fodder: Dan 4:22 ; 4:29 ; 4:30 ; 5:21 .
